command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; echo '=== REFERENCE CALL: DIALER DTMF 1 ==='; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; OFF=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo ref_call_state=$ST; if [ "$ST" = "2" ]; then OFF=1; break; fi; sleep 0.4; done; test "$OFF" = "1"; sleep 6; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dtmf 1; sleep 0.35; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" capture 2500 /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 1; ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo after_ref_state=$ST; test "$ST" = "0"; test -s /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav
